name: Accordion
description: Accordion is a component that allows you to collapse and expand content.

name: Alert
description: Alerts are used to communicate a state that affects a system, feature or page.

name: Avatar
description: Avatars are used to represent a user.

name: Badge
description: Badges are used to display a small amount of information.

name: Breadcrumbs
description: Breadcrumbs are used to indicate the current page\

name: Button
description: Buttons allow users to perform actions and make choices with a single click. They are commonly used for submitting forms, opening dialogs or menus, and executing commands. Buttons can be customized with different styles, sizes, and icons to fit various use cases.

name: Card
description: Cards are used to display content in an organized manner.

name: Carousel
description: A carousel is a rotating set of images.

name: Checkbox
description: Checkboxes enable users to select one or multiple options from a list. They are ideal for toggling settings or making selections where more than one choice is allowed. Each checkbox can be checked or unchecked independently.

name: Container
description: Containers provide a flexible layout element for grouping and organizing content. They help structure pages by controlling width, alignment, and spacing, ensuring consistent presentation across different sections.

name: Datepicker
description: The datepicker component is used to select a date or time.

name: Divider
description: Dividers are used to separate content.

name: Drawer
description: Drawers slide in from the edge of the screen to present navigation, options, or additional content without disrupting the main view. They are ideal for menus, filters, or contextual panels.

name: Empty
description: Empty states communicate when there is no content to show. Use them in tables, lists, and panels with a title, description, optional icon, and actions.

name: Form
description: Forms provide a structured way to collect and validate user input, such as text, selections, and files. They support features like validation, grouping, and submission handling, making it easy to build interactive and accessible data entry interfaces.

name: FormGroup
description: Form groups organize related form elements together, providing structure and shared validation. They help group checkboxes, radio buttons, or inputs that belong to the same logical section.

name: Icon
description: Icons visually represent actions and concepts. Register SVG paths in a global map, then reference them by name on XIcon.

name: Image
description: Loads a remote image after preloading. Use a background on the wrapper for a visible placeholder until load completes.

name: InfiniteLoader
description: InfiniteLoader is a component that allows you to load data on demand as users scroll through a list.

name: Input
description: This is a text input component that allows users to enter and edit text.

name: Input Group
description: Input groups combine multiple inline fields (Input, Textarea, Select, Datepicker, Button) into one control with a shared label and footer.

name: Link
description: Links are used to navigate to a different page.

name: Loader
description: Loader component is used to show a loading state.

name: Menu
description: Menus are used to display a list of options.

name: Modal
description: Modals are used to display content on top of the current page.

name: Notifications
description: Notifications provide timely feedback or alerts to users, such as success messages, warnings, or errors. They help keep users informed about important events or actions.

name: Pagination
description: Pagination divides large sets of content into manageable pages, allowing users to navigate through items efficiently. It is commonly used in tables, lists, and search results to improve usability and performance.

name: Popover
description: Popovers display additional information or interactive content in a floating overlay, anchored to a trigger element. They are useful for tooltips, menus, or contextual actions without navigating away from the current view.

name: Progress
description: Progress indicators visually communicate the completion status of a task or process, such as file uploads or data loading. They help users understand how much work remains.

name: QR Code
description: The QR Code component is used to generate a QR code.

name: Radio
description: Radios allow the user to select one option from a set. Use radio buttons for exclusive selection if you think that the user needs to see all available options side-by-side.

name: Scroll
description: The Scroll component enhances scrolling experiences by adding visual cues, such as inner shadows, to indicate additional content. It is useful for horizontally or vertically scrolling lists and containers.

name: Select
description: Selects allow the user to select one or more options from a set.

name: Skeleton
description: Skeletons provide placeholder elements that mimic the layout of content while data is loading. They improve perceived performance by giving users a visual cue that content is being fetched.

name: Slider
description: Sliders allow users to select a numeric value or range by dragging a handle along a track. They are ideal for adjusting settings such as volume, brightness, or price filters.

name: Spacer
description: Spacers create adjustable gaps between elements within flex layouts, helping to control spacing and alignment without using margin or padding directly.

name: Spinner
description: Spinners visually indicate that a background process or operation is ongoing, such as loading data or submitting a form. They help manage user expectations by signaling that the system is working.

name: Stepper
description: Multi-step wizard with declarative steps, named panel slots, programmatic next/prev navigation, validation hooks, and optional sidebar summaries.

name: Table
description: Tables display tabular data with single- or multi-column sorting, selection, expandable rows, and virtual lists.

name: Tabs
description: Tabs are used to navigate through a set of views.

name: Tag
description: Tags are compact elements used to display brief information, such as categories, statuses, or labels. They help organize content and provide quick context or filtering options within lists and interfaces.

name: Textarea
description: Textareas provide a multi-line input field for users to enter longer text, such as comments, descriptions, or messages. They support resizing and can be customized for different use cases.

name: Toggle
description: Toggles provide a simple switch interface for enabling or disabling a setting, or switching between two mutually exclusive states. They are ideal for binary options such as on/off, active/inactive, or show/hide.

name: Tooltip
description: Tooltips display contextual help on hover. Use XToggleTip for a compact info-icon pattern beside labels.

name: Upload
description: Upload is a component that allows you to upload files.

name: VirtualGrid
description: VirtualGrid is a component that allows you to render a grid of items in a virtualized way. It is a high-performance component that is used to render large grids of items.

name: VirtualList
description: VirtualList is a component that allows you to render a list of items in a virtualized way. It is a high-performance component that is used to render large lists of items.
